criteria.reasoning: Candidate consistently applied current v3 thresholds (10%/15%/5%/3%/20%), used the properly filtered NAV 1.0740 (explicitly flagging the unfiltered 1.1240 as a 499.77bp overstatement rather than using it), and filtered both holdings (as_of=2026-09-30) and prices (trade_date=2026-09-30) to the valuation date—documenting the 5 non-valuation-date price records removed and 6 non-valuation-date holding records excluded. All three invalid practices listed in N02 are absent.

criteria.name: N03
criteria.description: 编造数据或修改输入材料：交付物中出现输入材料内无法回溯且未标注待核实的数值；或对 `/app/input_files/` 下的文件进行了修改、删除、重命名或新增（含把派生结果写回输入目录）。仅当发现明确证据时判定成立；输入目录保持原状且数值可回溯的判定不成立。 Deliverables to inspect: /logs/artifacts/output, /app/input_files, /app/output/FIN3-WKN-153_operation_report.md.
criteria.reasoning: No evidence of data fabrication or input file modification. All numerical values in the deliverable trace back to source files: NAV (1,342,513,971.39) from nav_report_20260930.csv; cash (45,645,475.03) from bank_statement_20260930.csv; receivables/payables (4,278,200.00/2,763,450.00) from accruals_20260930.csv; R-01 breach value (161,214,619.60) and ratio (12.01%) correctly calculated from holdings and price data; filtering counts (6/5/4) verified. Input files remain unmodified (timestamps 03:23:38, before deliverables at 06:29-07:15, read-only permissions). Discrepancies properly flagged as '待核实' rather than fabricated. The reproduce script validates all calculations.

criteria.name: N04
criteria.description: 使用材料截止时点之后的信息：交付物引入 2026-10-08 之后形成的行情、整改完成结果、四季度数据或任何后续事实用于推导本期结论。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；仅使用截止时点前材料的判定不成立。 Deliverables to inspect: /app/output/FIN3-WKN-153_operation_report.md, /app/output/FIN3-WKN-153_quarterly_workbook.xlsx.
criteria.reasoning: Deliverables do not use information formed after the 2026-10-08 cutoff date. All referenced materials are dated on or before the cutoff (valuation data 2026-09-30, approval memo 2026-09-28, ops email 2026-10-08 on the cutoff date itself). The report explicitly marks incomplete information as 'to be verified' (待核实) rather than using subsequent remediation completion results or post-cutoff market data. No Q4 data or subsequent facts are introduced to derive conclusions. The deliverables clearly state the cutoff date and consistently use only materials available as of that date.
